basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Edinburgh Glenmore Medical Postgraduate Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: University of Edinburgh (College of Medicine and Veterinary Medicine)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Edinburgh (Edinburgh BioQuarter, Western General Hospital, and Central Campus)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Eligible postgraduate human medicine and surgical programmes across Edinburgh Medical School (Surgical Sciences, Clinical Oncology, Internal Medicine, Global Health & Infectious Diseases, Neuroimaging, and Critical Care).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~3 to 5 prestigious Glenmore Medical Scholarships awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to eligible developing nations; typically 1 to 2 Pakistani medical scholars selected per intake
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 12 months (for on-campus full-time master's) or standard duration for online surgical master's

nationality_requirements: Citizens and residents of eligible DAC developing countries including Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Open to early and mid-career medical doctors, surgeons, and healthcare practitioners.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized medical degree (MBBS / BDS / MD) or equivalent postgraduate health diploma from an HEC/PMDC-recognized medical institution with good academic record (minimum CGPA 3.00 / 4.00 or 70%+).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.00 / 4.00; competitive medical candidates typically hold CGPA >= 3.40 / 4.00 with verified clinical hospital training.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Must hold an offer (conditional or unconditional) to study an eligible medical or surgical postgraduate programme at the University of Edinburgh.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated with recognized primary medical qualification and actively practicing or conducting clinical research.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: No restriction on year of graduation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: House job completion and clinical medical or surgical experience in Pakistan is mandatory for admission to clinical master's tracks.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (minimum 6.0 in all bands), TOEFL iBT minimum 92, or verified primary medical qualification taught in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must demonstrate how they intend to use their medical training to benefit the healthcare system in their home country.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another full medical scholarship concurrently.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full international tuition fee waiver for eligible postgraduate medical and surgical master's programmes (worth up to GBP 38,500).
tuition_fee.amount: 100% Full Tuition Fee Waiver (up to GBP 38,500 value)

admission_application_fee.details: Applying for postgraduate medical programmes at Edinburgh is free via the online degree finder.

accommodation.details: University postgraduate medical residences located near Edinburgh BioQuarter and Little France.

monthly_stipend.details: Living bursary support provided for on-campus scholars to cover maintenance, with online scholars receiving full tuition coverage without living costs.
monthly_stipend.amount: Full tuition waiver award + bursary support

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Edinburgh is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: UK Student Visa fee (~GBP 490) and Immigration Health Surcharge covered by candidate for on-campus study (zero visa cost for online tracks).
visa_fee.amount: UK Visa & IHS fees borne by candidate (on-campus)

health_insurance.details: Full NHS coverage in Scotland for on-campus scholars.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized hospital and campus dining across Edinburgh BioQuarter.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full digital access to University of Edinburgh Medical Libraries, UpToDate, and BMJ Best Practice clinical decision tools.
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: Full medical library and UpToDate access

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Access to clinical research data sets, clinical simulation suites, and Edinburgh surgery surgical video libraries.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized Lothian bus student ridacard in Edinburgh.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (University of Edinburgh - College of Medicine and Veterinary Medicine, Edinburgh, Scotland, UK).
participating_institutions: University of Edinburgh - College of Medicine and Veterinary Medicine
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: World top 25 university in Medicine (QS World University Rankings by Subject); historical home of modern medicine.
available_majors: MSc in Surgical Sciences / ChM General Surgery
MSc in Global Health and Infectious Diseases
MSc in Neuroimaging for Clinical & Cognitive Neuroscience
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 1 year (for full-time on-campus MSc) or 2-3 years (part-time online clinical master's)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Primary medical degree (MBBS/BDS), house job completion, clinical medical experience, IELTS 6.5+ or medical MOI, and active Edinburgh admission offer.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Must apply for program admission to obtain a University Username (UUN) before submitting the Glenmore Scholarship application in MyEd.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Clearly explain how advanced clinical specialization will directly address healthcare deficits in public hospital settings in Pakistan.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: MyEd Applicant Portal & EUCLID Admissions System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Apply for an eligible medical/surgical master's programme at Edinburgh via Degree Finder. Step 2: Receive UUN login details for MyEd. Step 3: Access the Scholarships and Student Funding channel in MyEd and complete the Glenmore Scholarship online form before May 29.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Apply for admission to an eligible postgraduate medical or surgical programme at Edinburgh by late April.
Step 2: Receive your University Username (UUN) and log into the MyEd student portal.
Step 3: Locate the Glenmore Medical Postgraduate Scholarship in the 'Scholarship and Funding' channel.
Step 4: Answer the scholarship essay questions detailing clinical trajectory, financial need, and future healthcare impact in Pakistan.
Step 5: Submit the scholarship application before May 29, 23:59 BST.
Step 6: College of Medicine and Veterinary Medicine selection panel reviews and ranks eligible candidates.
Step 7: Successful recipients notified by late July.
Step 8: Accept scholarship award and finalize matriculation.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Separate Routing: Candidates must first apply for admission to an eligible medical programme, then submit the Glenmore Scholarship application via MyEd.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted as part of the initial programme application via EUCLID referee upload link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Structured statement demonstrating clinical dedication, financial need, and a clear plan to apply specialist medical training to improve patient outcomes in Pakistan.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Summary of clinical audit, quality improvement project, or research focus for master's dissertation.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Medical curriculum vitae detailing clinical rotations, house job, procedures performed, audits, and research.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews; decisions are based on clinical credentials, academic performance, and personal statement quality.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+ (min 6.0 each) or TOEFL iBT 92+ / verified medical MOI.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: GBP 0 (Free to apply for programme and scholarship)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and PMDC/PNC degree attestations from Pakistan.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation for all official records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via MyEd Student Portal.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Glenmore Scholarship closes May 29 (23:59 BST); medical programme admission application must be submitted at least 3 weeks earlier.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Medical school academic performance, professional exam marks, and honors)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 15% (Leadership in hospital clinical governance, medical student societies, community clinics)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (Clinical audits, case reports, medical research publications, and presentations)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 15% (Quality of clinical house job training and postgraduate residency experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 20% (Quality of personal statement detailing commitment to return and improve patient care in Pakistan)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: 0% (Qualifying prerequisite: candidate must demonstrate financial need)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: College of Medicine and Veterinary Medicine Postgraduate Scholarships Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Faculty review committee rates applicants on medical excellence, clinical dedication, and home country healthcare impact.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~300 to 500 international medical doctors applying for Glenmore awards
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2% to 4% among practicing medical doctors with strong clinical profiles
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.50 / 4.00 with solid clinical training and clear hospital leadership goals
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Medical doctors (MBBS) or surgical trainees with strong clinical house job records and commitment to public healthcare.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from King Edward Medical University, Dow University of Health Sciences, Aga Khan University, and Services Institute of Medical Sciences.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Nigeria, Kenya, Uganda, Ghana, Sudan, Malawi.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official University of Edinburgh portal https://www.ed.ac.uk/ and MyEd.
Never pay any fee to agents claiming to secure Glenmore Medical Scholarships.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying for medical courses and the Glenmore scholarship at Edinburgh is completely free.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: University of Edinburgh does not work with private recruitment consultancies for medical scholarships.
hidden_costs_breakdown: PMDC / HEC document attestation in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000 - 25,000.
UK Student Visa & IHS fees (if taking on-campus track): ~GBP 1,266 (~PKR 470,000).
Zero visa costs if studying eligible part-time online surgical master's tracks from Pakistan.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Glenmore scholarships only fund on-campus degrees. Reality: Glenmore awards support both on-campus master's and renowned Edinburgh online clinical and surgical master's programmes.
Myth: You need GMC UK registration to apply. Reality: GMC registration is NOT required for postgraduate academic master's degrees (only required for direct unsupervised NHS clinical practice).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sources claim IELTS can never be waived; medical graduates whose entire primary medical qualification was taught in English can be exempted by Edinburgh Medical School.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance and pass all clinical and academic assessments.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full participation in all required lectures, clinical simulation tutorials, and online seminars.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Term-by-term progress monitoring by Edinburgh Medical School board.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Online scholars may continue practicing medicine in Pakistan while studying part-time; on-campus scholars subject to standard UK visa rules.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: Scholars are expected to utilize their specialist skills to advance patient care and medical education in Pakistan.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Commitment to contributing to developing country healthcare systems.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation of award if scholar ceases registration or fails academic assessments without approved cause.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing programme requires approval from College of Medicine and Veterinary Medicine.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to the standard duration of the chosen medical master's programme.
